wiki.title: Kellie Deeter
wiki.extract: Kellie Deeter is an American politician serving as a member of the Ohio House of Representatives from the 54th district. A Republican, she was elected in the 2024 Ohio House of Representatives election. Born and raised in Huron County, Deeter earned a bachelors in Nursing from Bowling Green State, and a Doctor of Nursing Practice from Maryville University of St. Louis. Deeter is a nurse practitioner and anesthetist.
